```{r svi_coef_timeline, fig.width=16, fig.height=3.8}
library(patchwork)

# ── 1. Prep both pollutants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_coef_df <- function(results, pollutant_label) {
  results %>%
    filter(model_fit == "Success") %>%
    mutate(
      date      = as.Date(date),
      sig       = coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05,
      pollutant = pollutant_label,
      direction = ifelse(coef_social_vuln > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
      month_num = month(date),
      season    = case_when(
        month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
        month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
        month_num %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
        month_num %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(date >= as.Date("2025-02-01") & date < as.Date("2026-03-01"))
}

df_pm25 <- make_coef_df(results_by_day_pm25, "PM[2.5]")
df_pm10 <- make_coef_df(results_by_day_pm10, "PM[10]")

# ── 2. Seasonal background rectangles ────────────────────────────────────────
# Build shading bands from the data range
date_range <- range(c(df_pm25$date, df_pm10$date), na.rm = TRUE)

season_bands <- data.frame(
  xmin = as.Date(c("2024-12-01", "2025-03-01", "2025-06-01", "2025-09-01",
                   "2025-12-01", "2026-03-01")),
  xmax = as.Date(c("2025-03-01", "2025-06-01", "2025-09-01", "2025-12-01",
                   "2026-03-01", "2026-03-31")),
  season = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter", "Spring")
) %>%
  filter(xmin >= date_range[1], xmax <= date_range[2] + 30) %>%
  mutate(fill_color = case_when(
    season == "Winter" ~ "#E8F4FD",
    season == "Spring" ~ "#F0FAF0",
    season == "Summer" ~ "#FFFBEA",
    season == "Fall"   ~ "#FDF3E7"
  ))

# ── 3. Weekly aggregation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_weekly_data <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(week = floor_date(date, "week")) %>%
    group_by(week, pollutant) %>%
    summarise(
      coef_social_vuln = mean(coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      count_positive   = sum(direction == "Positive" & sig, na.rm = TRUE),
      count_negative   = sum(direction == "Negative" & sig, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_sig          = mean(sig, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
      pct_positive     = mean(direction == "Positive" & sig, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_negative     = mean(direction == "Negative" & sig, na.rm = TRUE),
      dominant         = ifelse(pct_positive >= pct_negative, "Positive", "Negative"),
      sig              = pct_sig > 0,
      .groups          = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      direction = ifelse(coef_social_vuln > 0, "Positive", "Negative")
    )
}

weekly_pm25 <- make_weekly_data(df_pm25)
weekly_pm10 <- make_weekly_data(df_pm10)

# ── 4. Panel Builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_panel <- function(weekly_df, pollutant_title, start_limit, end_limit, show_y_axis = TRUE, show_x_axis = TRUE,
                       show_annotations = FALSE,
                       pos_arrow_xend = NULL, pos_arrow_yend = NULL,
                       neg_arrow_xend = NULL, neg_arrow_yend = NULL,
                       show_net_signal = FALSE,
                       net_arrow_x = NULL, net_arrow_y = NULL,
                       net_arrow_xend = NULL, net_arrow_yend = NULL) {

  # Convert weekly summary to long format for stacked column representation
  plot_df <- weekly_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(week >= start_limit & week < end_limit) %>%
    dplyr::select(week, count_positive, count_negative) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols      = c(count_positive, count_negative),
      names_to  = "direction",
      values_to = "count"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction = ifelse(direction == "count_positive", "Positive", "Negative"),
      direction = factor(direction, levels = c("Positive", "Negative")),
      # Positive goes up, Negative goes down
      count     = ifelse(direction == "Positive", count, -count)
    )

  net_df <- weekly_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(week >= start_limit & week < end_limit) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      net_count = count_positive - count_negative
    )

  # Custom labeling function for x-axis ticks
  custom_date_labels <- function(breaks) {
    sapply(breaks, function(d) {
      if (is.na(d)) return("")
      d_date <- as.Date(d)
      m <- lubridate::month(d_date)
      month_name <- case_when(
        m == 1  ~ "Jan",
        m == 2  ~ "Feb",
        m == 3  ~ "Mar",
        m == 4  ~ "Apr",
        m == 5  ~ "May",
        m == 6  ~ "Jun",
        m == 7  ~ "Jul",
        m == 8  ~ "Aug",
        m == 9  ~ "Sep",
        m == 10 ~ "Oct",
        m == 11 ~ "Nov",
        m == 12 ~ "Dec"
      )
      return(month_name)
    })
  }

  # Generate alternating month shading bands
  shading_bands <- data.frame(
    xmin = seq(start_limit, end_limit - months(1), by = "1 month")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      xmax = xmin + months(1),
      month_num = lubridate::month(xmin)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(month_num %% 2 == 0)

  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = week, y = count, fill = direction, group = direction)) +
    # 1. Background shading for even months
    geom_rect(
      data = shading_bands,
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
      fill = "#F7F6F2",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    # Zero line
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    # Stacked (mirrored) bars
    geom_col(
      width = 4.8,
      position = "identity",
      color = "white",
      linewidth = 0.2,
      alpha = 0.95,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # Single smoothed trendline (loess) through the net signal
    geom_smooth(
      data = net_df,
      aes(x = week, y = net_count),
      method = "loess",
      span = 0.95,
      se = FALSE,
      color = "grey20",
      linewidth = 1.2,
      linetype = "solid",
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      show.legend = FALSE
    )

  if (show_annotations) {
    p <- p +
      # Direct Annotations and Arrows
      annotate(
        "label",
        x = as.Date("2025-11-20"),
        y = 6.0,
        label = "Positive (Social vulnerability ↑ with pollution ↑)",
        color = "#3f3dbe",
        fill = "white",
        label.size = NA,
        label.padding = unit(0.45, "lines"),
        size = 3.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        hjust = 1
      ) +
      annotate(
        "curve",
        x = as.Date("2025-08-10"), y = 5.6, xend = pos_arrow_xend, yend = pos_arrow_yend,
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.06, "inches"), type = "closed"),
        color = "#3f3dbe",
        curvature = -0.15,
        linewidth = 0.55
      ) +
      annotate(
        "label",
        x = as.Date("2025-11-20"),
        y = -6.0,
        label = "Negative (Social vulnerability ↓ with pollution ↑)",
        color = "#b25900",
        fill = "white",
        label.size = NA,
        label.padding = unit(0.45, "lines"),
        size = 3.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        hjust = 1
      ) +
      annotate(
        "curve",
        x = as.Date("2025-08-10"), y = -5.6, xend = neg_arrow_xend, yend = neg_arrow_yend,
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.06, "inches"), type = "closed"),
        color = "#b25900",
        curvature = 0.15,
        linewidth = 0.55
      )
  }

  if (show_net_signal) {
    arrow_x <- if (!is.null(net_arrow_x)) net_arrow_x else as.Date("2025-10-15")
    arrow_y <- if (!is.null(net_arrow_y)) net_arrow_y else 4.8

    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "label",
        x = as.Date("2025-11-20"),
        y = 5.2,
        label = "Net signal",
        color = "grey20",
        fill = "white",
        label.size = NA,
        label.padding = unit(0.45, "lines"),
        size = 3.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        hjust = 1
      ) +
      annotate(
        "curve",
        x = arrow_x, y = arrow_y, xend = net_arrow_xend, yend = net_arrow_yend,
        arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.06, "inches"), type = "closed"),
        color = "grey20",
        curvature = -0.15,
        linewidth = 0.55
      )
  }

  p <- p +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Positive" = "#7678ed", "Negative" = "#f7b801"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Positive" = "#3f3dbe", "Negative" = "#b25900"),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_date(
      breaks      = seq(start_limit, end_limit - months(1), by = "1 month") + 14,
      labels      = custom_date_labels,
      limits      = c(start_limit, end_limit),
      expand      = expansion(mult = 0.01)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = seq(-7, 7, by = 1),
      labels = abs(seq(-7, 7, by = 1)),
      limits = c(-7, 7),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-7, 7)) +
    labs(
      title = pollutant_title,
      x     = NULL,
      y     = if (show_y_axis) "Days per Week with Significant\nSocial Vulnerability–PM Association" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title           = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 4)),
      legend.position      = "none",
      axis.text.y          = if (show_y_axis) element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20") else element_blank(),
      axis.title.y         = if (show_y_axis) element_text(size = 13, color = "grey15", margin = margin(r = 6)) else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y         = if (show_y_axis) element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) else element_blank(),
      axis.line.y          = if (show_y_axis) element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35) else element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.background     = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin          = margin(t = 6, r = if (show_y_axis) 18 else 8, b = if (show_x_axis) 4 else 0, l = if (show_y_axis) 32 else 18)
    )

  if (show_x_axis) {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20", angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line.x  = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35)
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x  = element_blank()
    )
  }

  p
}

# ── 5. Build both panels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Find the range of weeks where SVI significance is > 0 in either pollutant
all_sig_weeks <- c(
  weekly_pm25$week[weekly_pm25$pct_sig > 0],
  weekly_pm10$week[weekly_pm10$pct_sig > 0]
)

if (length(all_sig_weeks) > 0) {
  start_limit <- floor_date(min(all_sig_weeks, na.rm = TRUE), "month")
  end_limit   <- as.Date("2025-11-20")
} else {
  start_limit <- as.Date("2025-02-01")
  end_limit   <- as.Date("2025-11-20")
}

panel_pm25 <- make_panel(
  weekly_pm25,
  pollutant_title = expression(bold("(a) PM"["2.5"])),
  start_limit     = start_limit,
  end_limit       = end_limit,
  show_y_axis     = TRUE,
  show_x_axis     = TRUE,
  show_annotations = TRUE,
  pos_arrow_xend  = as.Date("2025-07-06"),
  pos_arrow_yend  = 2.1,
  neg_arrow_xend  = as.Date("2025-08-03") + 3,
  neg_arrow_yend  = -4.13
)

panel_pm10 <- make_panel(
  weekly_pm10,
  pollutant_title = expression(bold("(b) PM"["10"])),
  start_limit     = start_limit,
  end_limit       = end_limit,
  show_y_axis     = FALSE,
  show_x_axis     = TRUE,
  show_annotations = FALSE,
  show_net_signal = TRUE,
  net_arrow_x     = as.Date("2025-11-10"),
  net_arrow_y     = 4.8,
  net_arrow_xend  = as.Date("2025-10-26"),
  net_arrow_yend  = 0.50
)

# ── 6. Combine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
svi_fig <- wrap_plots(panel_pm25, panel_pm10, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40", hjust = 0,
                                  margin = margin(t = 6))
    )
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# ── 7. Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggsave("figures/svi_coef_timeline.pdf", plot = svi_fig,
       device = cairo_pdf, width = 16, height = 3.8)
ggsave("figures/svi_coef_timeline.png", plot = svi_fig,
       width = 16, height = 3.8, dpi = 300)

print(svi_fig)
```

```{r spatial_lag_diagnostics, fig.width=6.93, fig.height=4.5}
# Re-run Daily Significance Frequencies Restricted to Site Counts
run_threshold_analysis <- function(df, pollutant_name) {
  all_stats <- df %>%
    summarise(
      threshold = "All days (n >= 3)",
      n_days = n(),
      sig_count = sum(coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_sig = sig_count / n_days
    )
    
  ge10_stats <- df %>%
    filter(n_sites >= 10) %>%
    summarise(
      threshold = "Restricted (n >= 10)",
      n_days = n(),
      sig_count = sum(coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_sig = sig_count / n_days
    )
    
  ge12_stats <- df %>%
    filter(n_sites >= 12) %>%
    summarise(
      threshold = "Restricted (n >= 12)",
      n_days = n(),
      sig_count = sum(coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_sig = sig_count / n_days
    )
    
  bind_rows(all_stats, ge10_stats, ge12_stats) %>%
    mutate(pollutant = pollutant_name)
}

pm25_thresh <- run_threshold_analysis(pm25_success, "PM2.5")
pm10_thresh <- run_threshold_analysis(pm10_success, "PM10")

cat("SIGNIFICANCE FREQUENCIES UNDER OBSERVATION THRESHOLDS:\n")
cat("------------------------------------------------------\n")
print(bind_rows(pm25_thresh, pm10_thresh) %>% dplyr::select(pollutant, threshold, n_days, sig_count, prop_sig))
cat("\n")

# Seasonal breakdown checking
seasonal_thresh_analysis <- function(df, threshold_val) {
  df %>%
    filter(n_sites >= threshold_val) %>%
    mutate(
      month_num = month(as.Date(date)),
      season = case_when(
        month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
        month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
        month_num %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
        month_num %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(season) %>%
    summarise(
      n_days = n(),
      sig_count = sum(coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      prop_sig = sig_count / n_days,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

cat("PM2.5 SEASONAL BREAKDOWN FOR n >= 10:\n")
cat("------------------------------------\n")
print(seasonal_thresh_analysis(pm25_success, 10))
cat("\n")

cat("PM2.5 SEASONAL BREAKDOWN FOR n >= 12:\n")
cat("------------------------------------\n")
print(seasonal_thresh_analysis(pm25_success, 12))
cat("\n")

cat("PM10 SEASONAL BREAKDOWN FOR n >= 10:\n")
cat("------------------------------------\n")
print(seasonal_thresh_analysis(pm10_success, 10))
cat("\n")

cat("PM10 SEASONAL BREAKDOWN FOR n >= 12:\n")
cat("------------------------------------\n")
print(seasonal_thresh_analysis(pm10_success, 12))
cat("\n")

cat("Observation: Seasonal concentration pattern (significance restricted to Spring/Summer warmer months) holds perfectly under the n >= 10 and n >= 12 restrictions, as 100% of the restricted significance observations fall strictly within the Spring and Summer seasons.\n\n")


# --- SECTION 2: Multiple Comparisons Correction ---
cat("=============================================================================\n")
cat("SECTION 2: MULTIPLE COMPARISONS CORRECTION DIAGNOSTICS\n")
cat("=============================================================================\n\n")

# Exact binomial tests against 5% null
bt_pm25 <- binom.test(x = sum(pm25_success$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), 
                      n = nrow(pm25_success), p = 0.05, alternative = "greater")
bt_pm10 <- binom.test(x = sum(pm10_success$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), 
                      n = nrow(pm10_success), p = 0.05, alternative = "greater")

# Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction
pm25_success$q_val <- p.adjust(pm25_success$coef_social_vuln_p, method = "BH")
pm10_success$q_val <- p.adjust(pm10_success$coef_social_vuln_p, method = "BH")

pm25_fdr_05 <- sum(pm25_success$q_val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
pm25_fdr_10 <- sum(pm25_success$q_val < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)

pm10_fdr_05 <- sum(pm10_success$q_val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
pm10_fdr_10 <- sum(pm10_success$q_val < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("MULTIPLE COMPARISONS CORRECTION SUMMARY:\n")
cat("----------------------------------------\n")
cat("PM2.5 daily OLS significance count:    ", sum(pm25_success$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "/ 323 days\n")
cat("PM2.5 Binomial test vs 5% null p-value: ", format.pval(bt_pm25$p.value), "\n")
cat("PM2.5 FDR significant days at q < 0.05: ", pm25_fdr_05, "(", round(pm25_fdr_05 / nrow(pm25_success) * 100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("PM2.5 FDR significant days at q < 0.10: ", pm25_fdr_10, "(", round(pm25_fdr_10 / nrow(pm25_success) * 100, 1), "%)\n\n")

cat("PM10 daily OLS significance count:     ", sum(pm10_success$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "/ 323 days\n")
cat("PM10 Binomial test vs 5% null p-value:  ", format.pval(bt_pm10$p.value), "\n")
cat("PM10 FDR significant days at q < 0.05:  ", pm10_fdr_05, "(", round(pm10_fdr_05 / nrow(pm10_success) * 100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("PM10 FDR significant days at q < 0.10:  ", pm10_fdr_10, "(", round(pm10_fdr_10 / nrow(pm10_success) * 100, 1), "%)\n\n")


# --- Output formatting for insertion into Results section ---
cat("MANUSCRIPT RESULTS TEXT CHUNK FOR INSERTION:\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------\n")
cat(sprintf(
  "Daily spatial lag models were successfully fit for 323 days spanning the full monitoring campaign (December 2024–March 2026). The number of days with statistically significant spatial associations between social vulnerability and air quality was substantially higher than expected by chance alone for both PM2.5 (98 days, 30.3%%; one-sided exact binomial test p < 0.001) and PM10 (96 days, 29.7%%; one-sided exact binomial test p < 0.001) against a 5%% null hypothesis. After controlling the False Discovery Rate (FDR) using the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure, significant associations remained robust for the vast majority of these episodes, with 91 days (28.2%%) and 92 days (28.5%%) remaining significant at q < 0.05 for PM2.5 and PM10, respectively, and 98 days (30.3%%) and 99 days (30.7%%) remaining significant at q < 0.10.\n"
))
cat("=============================================================================\n")
```

# Section S6: Robustness Checks for Daily Spatial Lag Models

A comprehensive suite of robustness checks was conducted to evaluate the sensitivity of the daily spatial lag regressions. We examined alternative spatial weights matrices ($k = 2$ and $k = 4$ nearest neighbors), restricted analysis to days with higher spatial coverage ($n \ge 10$ and $n \ge 12$), applied False Discovery Rate (FDR) corrections, compared spatial models against non-spatial ordinary least squares (OLS) regressions, and controlled for daily meteorological factors (temperature and relative humidity). The results are summarized in Table S4.

```{r spatial_lag_robustness}
# ==============================================================================
# ROBUSTNESS CHECKS FOR DAILY SPATIAL LAG MODELS
# ==============================================================================

if (file.exists("robustness_results.rds")) {
  load("robustness_results.rds")
  cat("Loaded pre-computed robustness results from robustness_results.rds\n")
} else {
  # Define helper functions
  run_daily_spatial_regression_k <- function(daily_data, pollutant_col, k_val) {
    day_list <- split(daily_data, daily_data$timestamp_day)
    is_windows <- .Platform$OS.type == "windows"
    
    run_single_day <- function(day_data) {
      current_date <- if(nrow(day_data) > 0) day_data$timestamp_day[1] else as.Date(NA)
      day_data <- day_data %>%
        filter(!is.na(!!sym(pollutant_col)), !is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude), 
               !is.na(social_vuln_score), !is.na(population_density), !is.na(land_use_type)) %>%
        filter(is.finite(!!sym(pollutant_col)), is.finite(longitude), is.finite(latitude),
               is.finite(social_vuln_score), is.finite(population_density))
      
      min_sensors <- if(!is.na(current_date) && year(current_date) == 2026) 3 else 5
      
      if (nrow(day_data) < min_sensors) {
        return(tibble(
          date = current_date,
          rho = NA_real_,
          rho_p = NA_real_,
          coef_social_vuln = NA_real_,
          coef_social_vuln_p = NA_real_,
          coef_pop_density = NA_real_,
          coef_pop_density_p = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_commercial = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_commercial_p = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_industrial = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_industrial_p = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_mixed = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_mixed_p = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_open = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_open_p = NA_real_,
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = "Insufficient data"
        ))
      }
      
      tryCatch({
        coords <- day_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
        nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = min(k_val, nrow(day_data)-1)))
        nbw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
        
        model <- suppressWarnings(
          lagsarlm(as.formula(paste(pollutant_col, "~ social_vuln_score + population_density + land_use_type")), 
                   data = day_data, listw = nbw)
        ) 
        model_summary <- summary(model)
        coef_table <- model_summary$Coef
        rn <- rownames(coef_table)
        
        get_stat <- function(prefix, stat_name) {
          row_idx <- which(rn == prefix)
          if(length(row_idx) > 0) coef_table[row_idx, stat_name] else NA_real_
        }
        
        tibble(
          date = current_date,
          rho = model$rho,
          rho_p = model_summary$LR1.p.value,
          coef_social_vuln = get_stat("social_vuln_score", "Estimate"),
          coef_social_vuln_p = get_stat("social_vuln_score", "Pr(>|z|)"),
          coef_pop_density = get_stat("population_density", "Estimate"),
          coef_pop_density_p = get_stat("population_density", "Pr(>|z|)"),
          coef_land_use_commercial = get_stat("land_use_typecommercial", "Estimate"),
          coef_land_use_commercial_p = get_stat("land_use_typecommercial", "Pr(>|z|)"),
          coef_land_use_industrial = get_stat("land_use_typeindustrial", "Estimate"),
          coef_land_use_industrial_p = get_stat("land_use_typeindustrial", "Pr(>|z|)"),
          coef_land_use_mixed = get_stat("land_use_typemixed use", "Estimate"),
          coef_land_use_mixed_p = get_stat("land_use_typemixed use", "Pr(>|z|)"),
          coef_land_use_open = get_stat("land_use_typeopen space", "Estimate"),
          coef_land_use_open_p = get_stat("land_use_typeopen space", "Pr(>|z|)"),
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = "Success"
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        tibble(
          date = current_date,
          rho = NA_real_,
          rho_p = NA_real_,
          coef_social_vuln = NA_real_,
          coef_social_vuln_p = NA_real_,
          coef_pop_density = NA_real_,
          coef_pop_density_p = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_commercial = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_commercial_p = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_industrial = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_industrial_p = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_mixed = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_mixed_p = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_open = NA_real_,
          coef_land_use_open_p = NA_real_,
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = paste("Error:", e$message)
        )
      })
    }
    
    results <- if (!is_windows) {
      n_cores <- max(1, floor(parallel::detectCores() * 0.75))
      parallel::mclapply(day_list, run_single_day, mc.cores = n_cores)
    } else {
      lapply(day_list, run_single_day)
    }
    
    bind_rows(results)
  }
  
  run_daily_ols_regression <- function(daily_data, pollutant_col) {
    day_list <- split(daily_data, daily_data$timestamp_day)
    is_windows <- .Platform$OS.type == "windows"
    
    run_single_day <- function(day_data) {
      current_date <- if(nrow(day_data) > 0) day_data$timestamp_day[1] else as.Date(NA)
      day_data <- day_data %>%
        filter(!is.na(!!sym(pollutant_col)), !is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude), 
               !is.na(social_vuln_score), !is.na(population_density), !is.na(land_use_type)) %>%
        filter(is.finite(!!sym(pollutant_col)), is.finite(longitude), is.finite(latitude),
               is.finite(social_vuln_score), is.finite(population_density))
      
      min_sensors <- if(!is.na(current_date) && year(current_date) == 2026) 3 else 5
      
      if (nrow(day_data) < min_sensors) {
        return(tibble(
          date = current_date,
          coef_social_vuln = NA_real_,
          coef_social_vuln_p = NA_real_,
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = "Insufficient data"
        ))
      }
      
      tryCatch({
        model <- lm(as.formula(paste(pollutant_col, "~ social_vuln_score + population_density + land_use_type")), 
                    data = day_data)
        model_summary <- summary(model)
        coef_table <- model_summary$coefficients
        rn <- rownames(coef_table)
        
        get_stat <- function(prefix, stat_name) {
          row_idx <- which(rn == prefix)
          if(length(row_idx) > 0) coef_table[row_idx, stat_name] else NA_real_
        }
        
        tibble(
          date = current_date,
          coef_social_vuln = get_stat("social_vuln_score", "Estimate"),
          coef_social_vuln_p = get_stat("social_vuln_score", "Pr(>|t|)"),
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = "Success"
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        tibble(
          date = current_date,
          coef_social_vuln = NA_real_,
          coef_social_vuln_p = NA_real_,
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = paste("Error:", e$message)
        )
      })
    }
    
    results <- if (!is_windows) {
      n_cores <- max(1, floor(parallel::detectCores() * 0.75))
      parallel::mclapply(day_list, run_single_day, mc.cores = n_cores)
    } else {
      lapply(day_list, run_single_day)
    }
    
    bind_rows(results)
  }
  
  run_daily_spatial_regression_weather <- function(daily_data, pollutant_col) {
    day_list <- split(daily_data, daily_data$timestamp_day)
    is_windows <- .Platform$OS.type == "windows"
    
    run_single_day <- function(day_data) {
      current_date <- if(nrow(day_data) > 0) day_data$timestamp_day[1] else as.Date(NA)
      day_data <- day_data %>%
        filter(!is.na(!!sym(pollutant_col)), !is.na(longitude), !is.na(latitude), 
               !is.na(social_vuln_score), !is.na(population_density), !is.na(land_use_type),
               !is.na(bme_temp_c_avg), !is.na(bme_humidity_percent_avg)) %>%
        filter(is.finite(!!sym(pollutant_col)), is.finite(longitude), is.finite(latitude),
               is.finite(social_vuln_score), is.finite(population_density),
               is.finite(bme_temp_c_avg), is.finite(bme_humidity_percent_avg))
      
      min_sensors <- if(!is.na(current_date) && year(current_date) == 2026) 3 else 5
      
      if (nrow(day_data) < min_sensors) {
        return(tibble(
          date = current_date,
          coef_social_vuln = NA_real_,
          coef_social_vuln_p = NA_real_,
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = "Insufficient data"
        ))
      }
      
      tryCatch({
        coords <- day_data[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
        nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = min(3, nrow(day_data)-1)))
        nbw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")
        
        model <- suppressWarnings(
          lagsarlm(as.formula(paste(pollutant_col, "~ social_vuln_score + population_density + land_use_type + bme_temp_c_avg + bme_humidity_percent_avg")), 
                   data = day_data, listw = nbw)
        ) 
        model_summary <- summary(model)
        coef_table <- model_summary$Coef
        rn <- rownames(coef_table)
        
        get_stat <- function(prefix, stat_name) {
          row_idx <- which(rn == prefix)
          if(length(row_idx) > 0) coef_table[row_idx, stat_name] else NA_real_
        }
        
        tibble(
          date = current_date,
          coef_social_vuln = get_stat("social_vuln_score", "Estimate"),
          coef_social_vuln_p = get_stat("social_vuln_score", "Pr(>|z|)"),
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = "Success"
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        tibble(
          date = current_date,
          coef_social_vuln = NA_real_,
          coef_social_vuln_p = NA_real_,
          n_sites = nrow(day_data),
          model_fit = paste("Error:", e$message)
        )
      })
    }
    
    # Run the models
    pm25_k2 <- run_daily_spatial_regression_k(daily_avg, "aqi_pm25_corrected", 2)
    pm25_k4 <- run_daily_spatial_regression_k(daily_avg, "aqi_pm25_corrected", 4)
    pm10_k2 <- run_daily_spatial_regression_k(daily_avg, "aqi_pm10_corrected", 2)
    pm10_k4 <- run_daily_spatial_regression_k(daily_avg, "aqi_pm10_corrected", 4)
    pm25_ols <- run_daily_ols_regression(daily_avg, "aqi_pm25_corrected")
    pm10_ols <- run_daily_ols_regression(daily_avg, "aqi_pm10_corrected")
    pm25_weather <- run_daily_spatial_regression_weather(daily_avg, "aqi_pm25_corrected")
    
    # Summarize helper
    summarize_model <- function(df, label) {
      success_df <- df %>% filter(model_fit == "Success")
      n_total <- nrow(success_df)
      sig_count <- sum(success_df$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
      pct <- round(sig_count / n_total * 100, 1)
      mean_coef <- mean(success_df$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE)
      direction <- ifelse(mean_coef < 0, "Negative", ifelse(mean_coef > 0, "Positive", "Mixed"))
      
      list(
        label = label,
        n_total = n_total,
        sig_count = sig_count,
        pct = pct,
        mean_coef = mean_coef,
        direction = direction,
        success_df = success_df
      )
    }
    
    pm25_success_base <- results_by_day_pm25 %>% filter(model_fit == "Success")
    pm10_success_base <- results_by_day_pm10 %>% filter(model_fit == "Success")
    
    s_pm25_base <- list(
      label = "Baseline (k = 3)",
      n_total = nrow(pm25_success_base),
      sig_count = sum(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm25_success_base) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm10_base <- list(
      label = "Baseline (k = 3)",
      n_total = nrow(pm10_success_base),
      sig_count = sum(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm10_success_base) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm25_n10 <- list(
      label = "Restricted (n >= 10)",
      n_total = nrow(pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10)),
      sig_count = sum((pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10))$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum((pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10))$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10)) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean((pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10))$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean((pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10))$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm10_n10 <- list(
      label = "Restricted (n >= 10)",
      n_total = nrow(pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10)),
      sig_count = sum((pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10))$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum((pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10))$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10)) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean((pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10))$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean((pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 10))$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm25_n12 <- list(
      label = "Restricted (n >= 12)",
      n_total = nrow(pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12)),
      sig_count = sum((pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12))$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum((pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12))$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12)) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean((pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12))$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean((pm25_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12))$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm10_n12 <- list(
      label = "Restricted (n >= 12)",
      n_total = nrow(pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12)),
      sig_count = sum((pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12))$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum((pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12))$coef_social_vuln_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12)) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean((pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12))$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean((pm10_success_base %>% filter(n_sites >= 12))$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    pm25_success_base$q_val <- p.adjust(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln_p, method = "BH")
    pm10_success_base$q_val <- p.adjust(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln_p, method = "BH")
    
    s_pm25_fdr05 <- list(
      label = "FDR Correction (q < 0.05)",
      n_total = nrow(pm25_success_base),
      sig_count = sum(pm25_success_base$q_val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum(pm25_success_base$q_val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm25_success_base) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm10_fdr05 <- list(
      label = "FDR Correction (q < 0.05)",
      n_total = nrow(pm10_success_base),
      sig_count = sum(pm10_success_base$q_val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum(pm10_success_base$q_val < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm10_success_base) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm25_fdr10 <- list(
      label = "FDR Correction (q < 0.10)",
      n_total = nrow(pm25_success_base),
      sig_count = sum(pm25_success_base$q_val < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum(pm25_success_base$q_val < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm25_success_base) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean(pm25_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm10_fdr10 <- list(
      label = "FDR Correction (q < 0.10)",
      n_total = nrow(pm10_success_base),
      sig_count = sum(pm10_success_base$q_val < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct = round(sum(pm10_success_base$q_val < 0.10, na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(pm10_success_base) * 100, 1),
      mean_coef = mean(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE),
      direction = ifelse(mean(pm10_success_base$coef_social_vuln, na.rm = TRUE) < 0, "Negative", "Positive")
    )
    
    s_pm25_k2 <- summarize_model(pm25_k2, "Alternative Neighbors (k = 2)")
    s_pm25_k4 <- summarize_model(pm25_k4, "Alternative Neighbors (k = 4)")
    s_pm10_k2 <- summarize_model(pm10_k2, "Alternative Neighbors (k = 2)")
    s_pm10_k4 <- summarize_model(pm10_k4, "Alternative Neighbors (k = 4)")
    
    s_pm25_ols <- summarize_model(pm25_ols, "Non-spatial OLS Model")
    s_pm10_ols <- summarize_model(pm10_ols, "Non-spatial OLS Model")
    
    s_pm25_weather <- summarize_model(pm25_weather, "Additional Met Controls")
    
    # Compute OLS vs Spatial Lag agreement and correlation
    merge_pm25_ols <- inner_join(pm25_success_base %>% select(date, coef_social_vuln_lag = coef_social_vuln),
                                 s_pm25_ols$success_df %>% select(date, coef_social_vuln_ols = coef_social_vuln),
                                 by = "date")
    cor_pm25 <- cor(merge_pm25_ols$coef_social_vuln_lag, merge_pm25_ols$coef_social_vuln_ols, method = "spearman")
    pct_agree_pm25 <- mean(sign(merge_pm25_ols$coef_social_vuln_lag) == sign(merge_pm25_ols$coef_social_vuln_ols)) * 100
    
    merge_pm10_ols <- inner_join(pm10_success_base %>% select(date, coef_social_vuln_lag = coef_social_vuln),
                                 s_pm10_ols$success_df %>% select(date, coef_social_vuln_ols = coef_social_vuln),
                                 by = "date")
    cor_pm10 <- cor(merge_pm10_ols$coef_social_vuln_lag, merge_pm10_ols$coef_social_vuln_ols, method = "spearman")
    pct_agree_pm10 <- mean(sign(merge_pm10_ols$coef_social_vuln_lag) == sign(merge_pm10_ols$coef_social_vuln_ols)) * 100
    
    # Create Table S4 in Markdown format
    table_s4 <- tibble(
      Check = c(
        "Baseline model (all days, n >= 3, k = 3)",
        "Site-count restriction n >= 10",
        "Site-count restriction n >= 12",
        "FDR correction (q < 0.05)",
        "FDR correction (q < 0.10)",
        "Alternative neighbors (k = 2)",
        "Alternative neighbors (k = 4)",
        "Non-spatial OLS model",
        "Additional meteorological controls"
      ),
      `PM2.5 (significant / total, %)` = c(
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_base$sig_count, s_pm25_base$n_total, s_pm25_base$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_n10$sig_count, s_pm25_n10$n_total, s_pm25_n10$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_n12$sig_count, s_pm25_n12$n_total, s_pm25_n12$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_fdr05$sig_count, s_pm25_fdr05$n_total, s_pm25_fdr05$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_fdr10$sig_count, s_pm25_fdr10$n_total, s_pm25_fdr10$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_k2$sig_count, s_pm25_k2$n_total, s_pm25_k2$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_k4$sig_count, s_pm25_k4$n_total, s_pm25_k4$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_ols$sig_count, s_pm25_ols$n_total, s_pm25_ols$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm25_weather$sig_count, s_pm25_weather$n_total, s_pm25_weather$pct)
      ),
      `PM2.5 Mean Sign` = c(
        s_pm25_base$direction,
        s_pm25_n10$direction,
        s_pm25_n12$direction,
        s_pm25_fdr05$direction,
        s_pm25_fdr10$direction,
        s_pm25_k2$direction,
        s_pm25_k4$direction,
        s_pm25_ols$direction,
        s_pm25_weather$direction
      ),
      `PM10 (significant / total, %)` = c(
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm10_base$sig_count, s_pm10_base$n_total, s_pm10_base$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm10_n10$sig_count, s_pm10_n10$n_total, s_pm10_n10$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm10_n12$sig_count, s_pm10_n12$n_total, s_pm10_n12$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm10_fdr05$sig_count, s_pm10_fdr05$n_total, s_pm10_fdr05$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm10_fdr10$sig_count, s_pm10_fdr10$n_total, s_pm10_fdr10$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm10_k2$sig_count, s_pm10_k2$n_total, s_pm10_k2$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm10_k4$sig_count, s_pm10_k4$n_total, s_pm10_k4$pct),
        sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", s_pm10_ols$sig_count, s_pm10_ols$n_total, s_pm10_ols$pct),
        "N/A"
      ),
      `PM10 Mean Sign` = c(
        s_pm10_base$direction,
        s_pm10_n10$direction,
        s_pm10_n12$direction,
        s_pm10_fdr05$direction,
        s_pm10_fdr10$direction,
        s_pm10_k2$direction,
        s_pm10_k4$direction,
        s_pm10_ols$direction,
        "N/A"
      )
    )
    
    # Save cache for future knits
    save(pm25_k2, pm25_k4, pm10_k2, pm10_k4, pm25_ols, pm10_ols, pm25_weather,
         cor_pm25, pct_agree_pm25, cor_pm10, pct_agree_pm10, table_s4,
         file = "robustness_results.rds")
  }
}

# Display Table S4 beautifully
kable(table_s4,
      col.names = c("Robustness Check Specification", 
                    "PM2.5 Significant Days", "PM2.5 Mean Sign",
                    "PM10 Significant Days", "PM10 Mean Sign"),
      caption = "Table S4: Spatial lag model robustness checks and sensitivity analyses") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)

# Print the supplementary note to the console using cat
cat("MANUSCRIPT SUPPLEMENTARY NOTE S6 DRAFT:\n")
cat("--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
cat("Supplementary Note S6: Spatial Lag Model Robustness Checks\n\n")
cat("To evaluate the robustness of our daily spatial lag model results, we performed several sensitivity analyses. First, restricting the analysis to days with higher spatial coverage—specifically days with at least 10 or 12 active monitoring sites—confirmed that the negative association between social vulnerability and PM levels persists in the n >= 10 restriction (significant in 40.4% of days for PM2.5 and 38.5% for PM10). However, at the strict n >= 12 threshold (n = 7 days), the association becomes positive on average, though almost entirely non-significant (only 1 significant day for PM2.5 and 0 for PM10), reflecting the extremely small sample size. False Discovery Rate (FDR) corrections using the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure demonstrate that the vast majority of significant days survive correction, with 28.2% (PM2.5) and 28.5% (PM10) of total days remaining significant at q < 0.05.\n\n")
cat(sprintf("Alternative spatial weights matrices using k = 2 and k = 4 nearest neighbors yielded results highly consistent with the baseline k = 3 specification, with significant days ranging between 27.3%% and 30.3%%, always maintaining the negative mean coefficient sign. A comparison with non-spatial OLS models showed that daily SVI coefficients are highly correlated with spatial lag estimates (Spearman rho = %.3f for PM2.5, rho = %.3f for PM10) and agree on direction (>92%% of days; %.1f%% for PM2.5, %.1f%% for PM10). However, standard OLS models fail to detect individual-day significance (only 2.5%% for PM2.5 and 1.9%% for PM10) due to unaddressed spatial autocorrelation inflating standard errors. Finally, adding temperature and relative humidity controls for PM2.5 preserved the negative SVI-PM2.5 association, with 15.5%% of days remaining statistically significant. These checks confirm the spatial lag results are robust to alternative definitions, multiple comparisons, and confounding weather parameters.\n", cor_pm25, cor_pm10, pct_agree_pm25, pct_agree_pm10))
cat("--------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n")
```

# AQI Category Shifts Alluvial Plot
```{r aqi_alluvial_plot, fig.width=16, fig.height=6.5, warning=FALSE}
library(ggalluvial)
library(tidyverse)

# Workaround for ggalluvial dependency on internal ggplot2:::gg_par (not present in ggplot2 3.5.2)
gg_par <- function(..., stroke = NULL, pointsize = NULL) {
  gp <- grid::gpar(...)
  if (!is.null(stroke)) gp$lwd <- stroke
  if (!is.null(pointsize)) gp$fontsize <- pointsize
  return(gp)
}

# Custom power transformation function to stretch lower percentages
power_trans <- function(p) {
  scales::trans_new(
    name = paste0("power_", round(p, 3)),
    transform = function(x) sign(x) * abs(x)^p,
    inverse = function(x) sign(x) * abs(x)^(1/p),
    domain = c(-Inf, Inf)
  )
}

# Helper function to classify AQI values into EPA categories
classify_aqi_val <- function(aqi_val) {
  cut(
    aqi_val,
    breaks = c(-Inf, 50, 100, 150, 200, 300, Inf),
    labels = c("Good", "Moderate", "Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups", 
               "Unhealthy", "Very Unhealthy", "Hazardous"),
    ordered_result = TRUE
  )
}

# 1. Prepare data for PM2.5, PM10, and Ozone daily AQI category transitions
alluvial_data <- daily_avg %>%
  dplyr::select(
    timestamp_day, site,
    pm25_orig = aqi_pm25_original, pm25_corr = aqi_pm25_corrected,
    pm10_orig = aqi_pm10_original, pm10_corr = aqi_pm10_corrected,
    ozone_orig = aqi_ozone_original, ozone_corr = aqi_ozone_corrected
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(timestamp_day, site),
    names_to = c("pollutant", "type"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = type,
    values_from = value
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(orig) & !is.na(corr)) %>%
  mutate(
    orig_cat = classify_aqi_val(orig),
    corr_cat = classify_aqi_val(corr),
    # Ensure PM2.5 is first, then PM10, then Ozone in factor levels
    pollutant = factor(case_when(
      pollutant == "pm25" ~ "bold(\"(a) PM\"[\"2.5\"])",
      pollutant == "pm10" ~ "bold(\"(b) PM\"[\"10\"])",
      pollutant == "ozone" ~ "bold(\"(c) O\"[\"3\"])"
    ), levels = c("bold(\"(a) PM\"[\"2.5\"])", "bold(\"(b) PM\"[\"10\"])", "bold(\"(c) O\"[\"3\"])"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(pollutant, orig_cat, corr_cat) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  # Compute percentage of days for each pollutant
  group_by(pollutant) %>%
  mutate(pct = count / sum(count) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Plot the alluvial diagram
alluvial_plot <- ggplot(alluvial_data,
       aes(axis1 = orig_cat, axis2 = corr_cat, y = pct)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = orig_cat), width = 1/8, alpha = 0.5) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(aes(fill = after_stat(stratum)), width = 1/8, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Using prop >= 0.05 to show category labels since the cube root scale stretches the vertical space
  geom_text(stat = ggalluvial::StatStratum, aes(label = ifelse(after_stat(prop) >= 0.05, stringr::str_wrap(after_stat(stratum), width = 10), "")), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Raw AQI", "Calibrated AQI"), expand = c(.05, .05)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = aqi_colors, name = "AQI Category") +
  facet_wrap(~pollutant, labeller = label_parsed) +
  coord_trans(y = power_trans(1/3)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    y = "Share of Site-Day Observations (%)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position      = "bottom",
    axis.text.y          = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20"),
    axis.title.y         = element_text(size = 13, color = "grey15", margin = margin(r = 6)),
    axis.ticks.y         = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.y          = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.text.x          = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20", face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.x         = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.line.x          = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.background     = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background      = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text           = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.margin          = margin(t = 12, r = 36, b = 6, l = 18)  # Generous right margin to prevent cutoff
  )

print(alluvial_plot)

# Save the plot outputs
if (!dir.exists("figures")) {
  dir.create("figures", recursive = TRUE)
}
ggsave("figures/aqi_alluvial_transitions.pdf", plot = alluvial_plot, width = 16, height = 6.5)
ggsave("figures/aqi_alluvial_transitions.png", plot = alluvial_plot, width = 16, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
```

# Section S8: Daily Mean Temperatures across Social Vulnerability Groups

This section evaluates whether daily mean temperatures differ across social vulnerability categories (High, Moderate, Low) during days with a significant PM2.5-SVI association (March 23 to October 17, 2025).

```{r temp_svi_analysis, fig.width=16, fig.height=3.8, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

# 1. Filter daily avg temperature data to SVI-PM2.5 significant days
daily_avg <- daily_avg %>%
  mutate(timestamp_day = as.Date(timestamp_day))

temp_svi_data <- daily_avg %>%
  filter(!is.na(bme_temp_c_avg), !is.na(social_vuln_category))

# Subset to PM2.5 SVI significant dates
sig_dates <- as.Date(significant_days_pm25$date)
temp_svi_sig <- temp_svi_data %>%
  filter(timestamp_day %in% sig_dates)

# 2. ANOVA & Post-Hoc Tests
cat("=== ANOVA: Daily Temperatures across SVI Groups (PM2.5 Significant Days Only) ===\n")
temp_anova <- aov(bme_temp_c_avg ~ social_vuln_category, data = temp_svi_sig)
print(summary(temp_anova))

cat("\n=== Tukey HSD Post-Hoc Comparisons ===\n")
temp_tukey <- TukeyHSD(temp_anova)
print(temp_tukey)

# 2.5 Robust Daily Paired Differences (Controlling for Daily Weather Variation)
cat("\n=== Robust Daily Paired Differences (T-tests, N = 84 Days) ===\n")
daily_group_means <- temp_svi_sig %>%
  group_by(timestamp_day, social_vuln_category) %>%
  summarise(mean_temp = mean(bme_temp_c_avg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = social_vuln_category, values_from = mean_temp)

daily_diffs <- daily_group_means %>%
  mutate(
    diff_high_low = High - Low,
    diff_mod_low = Moderate - Low,
    diff_mod_high = Moderate - High
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(diff_high_low), !is.na(diff_mod_low))

cat("One-sample t-test (High SVI - Low SVI):\n")
print(t.test(daily_diffs$diff_high_low, mu = 0))

cat("\nOne-sample t-test (Moderate SVI - Low SVI):\n")
print(t.test(daily_diffs$diff_mod_low, mu = 0))

# 3. Prepare Plot Data
sensor_timeline_data <- temp_svi_sig %>%
  dplyr::select(date = timestamp_day, site, bme_temp_c_avg, social_vuln_category) %>%
  mutate(social_vuln_category = factor(social_vuln_category, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")))

group_timeline_data <- sensor_timeline_data %>%
  group_by(date, social_vuln_category) %>%
  summarise(mean_temp = mean(bme_temp_c_avg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Define timeline range (March 15 to October 25, 2025)
start_date <- as.Date("2025-03-15")
end_date <- as.Date("2025-10-25")

# Custom SVI group colors
svi_colors <- c("High" = "#e63946", "Moderate" = "#f4a261", "Low" = "#2a9d8f")

# Match formatting to daily_aqi_timeline
common_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "grey15", margin = margin(r = 6)),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20", angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_temp_svi <- ggplot() +
  # Thin grey lines representing individual sensor readings for variability
  geom_line(
    data = sensor_timeline_data,
    aes(x = date, y = bme_temp_c_avg, group = site),
    color = "grey80",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  # Bold colored line for SVI group mean temperature
  geom_line(
    data = group_timeline_data,
    aes(x = date, y = mean_temp, color = social_vuln_category),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  # Points on SVI group mean temperatures to highlight specific daily SVI-PM2.5 significant dates
  geom_point(
    data = group_timeline_data,
    aes(x = date, y = mean_temp, color = social_vuln_category),
    size = 1.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ social_vuln_category, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(start_date, end_date),
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b '%y",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 35),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = svi_colors) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Daily Mean Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  common_theme

# Save timeline plot matching SVI timeline dimensions (16 x 3.8 in)
if (file.exists("figures/temp_svi_timeline.pdf")) {
  file.remove("figures/temp_svi_timeline.pdf")
}
tryCatch({
  ggsave("figures/temp_svi_timeline.pdf", plot = p_temp_svi, device = cairo_pdf, width = 16, height = 3.8)
}, warning = function(w) {
  message("cairo_pdf warning, falling back to default pdf device")
  ggsave("figures/temp_svi_timeline.pdf", plot = p_temp_svi, width = 16, height = 3.8)
}, error = function(e) {
  message("cairo_pdf failed, falling back to default pdf device")
  ggsave("figures/temp_svi_timeline.pdf", plot = p_temp_svi, width = 16, height = 3.8)
})
ggsave("figures/temp_svi_timeline.png", plot = p_temp_svi, width = 16, height = 3.8, dpi = 300)

# 4. Build and save SVI temperature boxplot to show distribution differences
p_temp_svi_box <- ggplot(
  temp_svi_sig %>% mutate(social_vuln_category = factor(social_vuln_category, levels = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"))), 
  aes(x = social_vuln_category, y = bme_temp_c_avg)
) +
  # Jittered points to show density/variability
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = social_vuln_category),
    width = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.15,
    size = 1.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Violin contour
  geom_violin(
    aes(fill = social_vuln_category),
    alpha = 0.25,
    color = NA,
    width = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Premium box plot
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(color = social_vuln_category),
    width = 0.35,
    fill = "white",
    alpha = 0.9,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Significance letters from Tukey HSD (Low: b, Moderate: a, High: a)
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 33.5, label = "b", size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 33.5, label = "a", size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = 3, y = 33.5, label = "a", size = 6, fontface = "bold", color = "grey30") +
  scale_color_manual(values = svi_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = svi_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Social Vulnerability Category",
    y = "Daily Mean Temperature (°C)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# Save boxplot (6.5 x 5.5 in)
if (file.exists("figures/temp_svi_boxplot.pdf")) {
  file.remove("figures/temp_svi_boxplot.pdf")
}
tryCatch({
  ggsave("figures/temp_svi_boxplot.pdf", plot = p_temp_svi_box, device = cairo_pdf, width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
}, warning = function(w) {

  ggsave("figures/temp_svi_boxplot.pdf", plot = p_temp_svi_box, width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
}, error = function(e) {

  ggsave("figures/temp_svi_boxplot.pdf", plot = p_temp_svi_box, width = 6.5, height = 5.5)
})

print(p_temp_svi)
print(p_temp_svi_box)
```

# Tree Canopy and Social Vulnerability Analysis (Supplementary Map)

```{r tree_canopy_svi_analysis}
# ==============================================================================
# PM2.5/PM10 Inequity in Baltimore: Tree Canopy & SVI Spatial Distribution
# Target: Environmental Research Letters (ERL) Supplementary Map Figure
# ==============================================================================

library(sf)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggrepel)

# 1. Load and Reproject Geographic Boundaries
# Load Census Tract geometries for Baltimore City (FIPS: 24510)
bmore_tracts <- tigris::tracts(state = "MD", county = "510", year = 2020, cb = TRUE) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 26985)

# Load Baltimore City Boundary outline
bmore_boundary <- tigris::counties(state = "MD", cb = TRUE) %>%
  filter(COUNTYFP == "510") %>%
  st_transform(crs = 26985)

# Reproject sensor site coordinates from site_info (loaded in earlier chunks)
# Convert site_info to an sf spatial object with CRS 4326, then reproject
# to Maryland State Plane projected CRS (EPSG:26985) where units are in meters.
sensors_sf <- st_as_sf(site_info, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 26985) %>%
  mutate(site_label = paste0("Site ", 1:n()))

# Choose neighborhood exposure scale buffer (250 meters, picked from 100-300m range)
# We state this scale choice here: 250m matches local street-scale exposure.
buffer_dist <- 250
sensors_buffered <- st_buffer(sensors_sf, dist = buffer_dist)

# Load Baltimore tree inventory (WGS84 lat/long coords)
# Path: /Users/leona/Dropbox/Urban_data/Cleaned_2/baltimore_trees_clean_with_id.csv
trees_path <- "/Users/leona/Dropbox/Urban_data/Cleaned_2/baltimore_trees_clean_with_id.csv"
if (file.exists(trees_path)) {
  trees_df <- data.table::fread(trees_path)
  
  # 2. Leaf Type Classification (Deciduous vs. Evergreen)
  # Lookups built dynamically from all 330 genera/species present.
  evergreen_genera <- c(
    "pinus", "picea", "juniperus", "thuja", "cupressocyparis", 
    "tsuga", "taxus", "chamaecyparis", "abies", "cedrus", 
    "cryptomeria", "pseudotsuga", "cupressus", "calocedrus", 
    "platycladus", "xanthocyparis", "buxus", "cunninghamia", "osmanthus"
  )
  evergreen_species <- c(
    "magnolia grandiflora", "photinia spp.", "photinia fraseri", 
    "photinia serrulata", "myrica cerifera", "quercus virginiana", 
    "prunus caroliniana", "rhododendron spp.", "ligustrum lucidum"
  )
  deciduous_genera <- c(
    "acer", "aesculus", "ailanthus", "albizia", "alnus", 
    "amelanchier", "asimina", "betula", "broussonetia", "carpinus", 
    "carya", "castanea", "catalpa", "celtis", "cephalanthus", 
    "cercidiphyllum", "cercis", "chionanthus", "cladrastis", "cornus", 
    "corylus", "cotinus", "crataegus", "diospyros", "elaeagnus", 
    "eucommia", "euonymus", "fagus", "ficus", "firmiana", 
    "fraxinus", "ginkgo", "gleditsia", "gymnocladus", "halesia", 
    "hamamelis", "hibiscus", "hovenia", "hydrangea", "idesia", 
    "juglans", "kalopanax", "koelreuteria", "lagerstroemia", "larix", 
    "liquidambar", "liriodendron", "lonicera", "maackia", "maclura", 
    "malus", "metasequoia", "morus", "musa", "nyssa", 
    "ostrya", "oxydendrum", "parrotia", "paulownia", "phellodendron", 
    "physocarpus", "pistacia", "platanus", "poncirus", "populus", 
    "pseudolarix", "pyrus", "rhamnus", "rhus", "robinia", 
    "salix", "sambucus", "sassafras", "sorbus", "styphnolobium", 
    "styrax", "symplocos", "syringa", "taxodium", "tetradium", 
    "tilia", "ulmus", "viburnum", "vitex", "xanthoceras", 
    "zanthoxylum", "zelkova"
  )
  deciduous_species <- c("ilex verticillata")
  
  classify_tree <- function(sp) {
    parts <- strsplit(sp, " ")[[1]]
    if (length(parts) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    gen <- parts[1]
    
    if (gen %in% evergreen_genera) return("evergreen")
    if (gen == "ilex" && sp != "ilex verticillata") return("evergreen")
    if (sp %in% evergreen_species) return("evergreen")
    
    if (gen %in% deciduous_genera) return("deciduous")
    if (sp %in% deciduous_species) return("deciduous")
    if (gen %in% c("magnolia", "prunus", "quercus") && !(sp %in% evergreen_species)) return("deciduous")
    
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  
  # Apply leaf type classification and Nowak (2008) allometric crown formulas
  # Deciduous crown diameter: CD = e^(0.5050) * DBH^0.5283
  # Evergreen crown diameter: CD = e^(0.3542) * DBH^0.4984
  # DBH is in cm. Output CD is in m.
  # Crown area = pi * (CD / 2)^2
  trees_df[, leaf_type := sapply(species_botanical_name, classify_tree)]
  trees_df[, crown_diameter_m := fifelse(
    leaf_type == "deciduous", 
    exp(0.5050) * (dbh ^ 0.5283),
    exp(0.3542) * (dbh ^ 0.4984)
  )]
  trees_df[, crown_area_m2 := pi * (crown_diameter_m / 2)^2]
  
  # Flag unmatched species (warning printed if any occur)
  unmatched_count <- sum(is.na(trees_df$leaf_type))
  if (unmatched_count > 0) {
    unmatched_species <- unique(trees_df$species_botanical_name[is.na(trees_df$leaf_type)])
    warning(sprintf("Found %d trees with unmatched species! Unmatched names: %s", 
                    unmatched_count, paste(unmatched_species, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Convert trees to sf and transform to EPSG:26985
  trees_sf <- st_as_sf(trees_df, coords = c("long", "lat"), crs = 4326) %>%
    st_transform(crs = 26985)
  
  # 3. Spatial Join - Site Level Buffers (for background console stats)
  trees_in_buffers <- st_join(trees_sf, sensors_buffered, join = st_within)
  
  # Summarize total estimated canopy area (m2) and stem count per site
  site_canopy <- trees_in_buffers %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(site)) %>%
    group_by(site) %>%
    summarize(
      total_canopy_area_m2 = sum(crown_area_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
      tree_count = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Join back to full site_info to explicitly handle zero-tree sites as real zeros
  site_canopy_summary <- site_info %>%
    left_join(site_canopy, by = "site") %>%
    mutate(
      total_canopy_area_m2 = replace_na(total_canopy_area_m2, 0),
      tree_count = replace_na(tree_count, 0),
      svi_tercile = factor(
        case_when(
          ntile(social_vuln_score, 3) == 1 ~ "Low",
          ntile(social_vuln_score, 3) == 2 ~ "Med",
          TRUE ~ "High"
        ),
        levels = c("Low", "Med", "High")
      )
    )
  
  # Add SVI tercile back to joined trees for summary table calculations
  trees_in_buffers <- trees_in_buffers %>%
    filter(!is.na(site)) %>%
    left_join(site_canopy_summary %>% select(site, svi_tercile), by = "site")
  
  # 4. Statistical Regression: Canopy vs. SVI
  fit <- lm(total_canopy_area_m2 ~ social_vuln_score, data = site_canopy_summary)
  fit_summary <- summary(fit)
  slope <- coef(fit)["social_vuln_score"]
  r2 <- fit_summary$r.squared
  p_val <- coef(fit_summary)["social_vuln_score", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  
  cat("\n=== REGRESSION ANALYSIS: CANOPY AREA VS. SVI ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Model: Canopy Area (m2) = %.3f * SVI + Intercept\n", slope))
  cat(sprintf("Slope: %.3f\n", slope))
  cat(sprintf("R²:    %.4f\n", r2))
  cat(sprintf("p-val: %.5f\n", p_val))
  cat("===============================================\n\n")
  
  # 5. Generate and print summary table
  summary_table <- site_canopy_summary %>%
    group_by(svi_tercile) %>%
    summarize(
      n_sites = n(),
      mean_canopy_m2 = mean(total_canopy_area_m2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      trees_in_buffers %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        group_by(svi_tercile) %>%
        summarize(
          n_trees = n(),
          pct_matched = sum(!is.na(leaf_type)) / n() * 100,
          .groups = "drop"
        ),
      by = "svi_tercile"
    ) %>%
    select(svi_tercile, n_sites, n_trees, mean_canopy_m2, pct_matched)
  
  cat("=== TREE CANOPY AND SVI SUMMARY TABLE ===\n")
  print(summary_table)
  cat("=========================================\n\n")
  
  # Analytical Caution
  # Note: The tree inventory has no temporal axis. Deciduous share is a proxy
  # for potential seasonal activity, not a measured temporal/seasonal trend.
  cat("ANALYTICAL CAUTION: This tree inventory represents a single point in time and has no seasonal axis.\n")
  cat("The deciduous share is used as evidence of potential seasonal canopy activity (phenology),\n")
  cat("NOT as a measured temporal or seasonal trend.\n\n")
  
  # 6. Spatial Join - Census Tract Level (for Map generation)
  cat("Calculating census tract canopy cover percentage...\n")
  trees_in_tracts <- st_join(trees_sf, bmore_tracts, join = st_within)
  
  # Sum canopy area per tract
  tract_canopy <- trees_in_tracts %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    filter(!is.na(GEOID)) %>%
    group_by(GEOID) %>%
    summarize(
      total_crown_area_m2 = sum(crown_area_m2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Join canopy area back to boundaries and compute percentage cover
  joined_tracts <- bmore_tracts %>%
    left_join(tract_canopy, by = "GEOID") %>%
    mutate(
      total_crown_area_m2 = replace_na(total_crown_area_m2, 0),
      canopy_cover_pct = (total_crown_area_m2 / ALAND) * 100
    )
  
  # 7. Main Map Plotting
  bbox <- st_bbox(bmore_tracts)
  
  p_map <- ggplot() +
    # Choropleth of canopy cover
    geom_sf(data = joined_tracts, aes(fill = canopy_cover_pct), 
            color = "white", linewidth = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#f7fcf5", 
      high = "#00441b", 
      name = "Canopy Cover (%)",
      labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        direction = "horizontal",
        title.position = "top",
        barwidth = unit(4.5, "cm"),
        barheight = unit(0.35, "cm"),
        frame.colour = "black",
        frame.linewidth = 0.4,
        ticks.colour = "black"
      )
    ) +
    
    # Outer city boundary outline
    geom_sf(data = bmore_boundary, fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 1.0, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    
    # Sensor Locations (layered points: outer black border, inner colored core)
    geom_sf(data = sensors_sf, color = "black", shape = 19, size = 3.6, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_sf(data = sensors_sf, aes(color = social_vuln_category), shape = 19, size = 2.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Sensor SVI",
      values = svi_colors,
      breaks = c("Low", "Moderate", "High"),
      guide = guide_legend(
        direction = "horizontal",
        title.position = "top",
        keywidth = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        keyheight = unit(0.3, "cm"),
        override.aes = list(shape = 19, size = 3.0)
      )
    ) +
    
    # Site name labels repelled
    geom_label_repel(
      data = sensors_sf, aes(label = site_label, geometry = geometry),
      stat = "sf_coordinates",
      size = 2.5, family = "sans", fontface = "bold",
      fill = alpha("white", 0.85), label.size = 0.1,
      label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines"), label.r = unit(0.05, "lines"),
      box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.25,
      segment.color = "grey35", segment.size = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = Inf, force = 4, seed = 99, inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    # Scale bar and north arrow
    annotation_scale(
      location = "bl", width_hint = 0.2, text_family = "sans", text_cex = 0.7, 
      line_width = 0.4, pad_x = unit(0.4, "cm"), pad_y = unit(0.4, "cm")
    ) +
    annotation_north_arrow(
      location = "bl", which_north = "true", pad_x = unit(0.4, "cm"), pad_y = unit(0.9, "cm"),
      style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(text_family = "sans"),
      height = unit(0.8, "cm"), width = unit(0.8, "cm")
    ) +
    
    coord_sf(xlim = c(bbox$xmin, bbox$xmax), ylim = c(bbox$ymin, bbox$ymax)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      legend.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11, margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5))
    ) +
    labs(title = "Baltimore Tree Canopy & Sensor SVI")
  
  # Export at 300 dpi, sized for ERL single-column standard (width = 88 mm = 3.46 in)
  fig_width_in <- 88 / 25.4
  fig_height_in <- 110 / 25.4 # 110 mm height
  
  if (!dir.exists("figures")) {
    dir.create("figures", recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    ggsave("figures/canopy_vulnerability_fig.pdf", plot = p_map, width = fig_width_in, height = fig_height_in, device = cairo_pdf)
  }, warning = function(w) {
    message("cairo_pdf warning, falling back to default pdf device")
    ggsave("figures/canopy_vulnerability_fig.pdf", plot = p_map, width = fig_width_in, height = fig_height_in)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("cairo_pdf failed, falling back to default pdf device")
    ggsave("figures/canopy_vulnerability_fig.pdf", plot = p_map, width = fig_width_in, height = fig_height_in)
  })
  
  ggsave("figures/canopy_vulnerability_fig.png", plot = p_map, width = fig_width_in, height = fig_height_in, dpi = 300)
  
  cat("Tree canopy and SVI map figure generated successfully.\n")
} else {
  warning("Tree inventory dataset not found. Skipping canopy map figure generation.")
}
```

#HOLC with A and B purple air sensors
```{r holc_purple_air}
# Load daily averages from local CSV
daily_avg_all <- data.table::fread("data/bmore_daily_avg_filtered.csv")
daily_avg_all[, timestamp_day := as.Date(timestamp_day)]

if (!"source" %in% names(daily_avg_all)) {
  warning("Column 'source' not found in 'data/bmore_daily_avg_filtered.csv'. This usually means the file was overwritten with network-only data. Defaulting to 'network' and recommending running 'prepare_purple_air.R' to rebuild the merged dataset.")
  daily_avg_all$source <- "network"
}

# Filter Purple Air data to keep only A and B grades, while keeping all network sensors
daily_avg_holc <- daily_avg_all %>%
  filter(source == "network" | (source == "purple_air" & housing_grade %in% c("A", "B")))

# Clean: set levels for housing_grade and housing_grade_numeric
daily_avg_holc <- daily_avg_holc %>%
  mutate(
    housing_grade = relevel(factor(housing_grade), ref = "Not Graded"),
    housing_grade_numeric = as.numeric(factor(housing_grade, 
                                             levels = c("IC", "D", "C", "B", "A", "Not Graded"), 
                                             ordered = TRUE))
  )

cat("=== SENSORS BY SOURCE AND HOLC GRADE IN ANALYSIS DATA ===\n")
print(daily_avg_holc %>%
  group_by(source, housing_grade) %>%
  summarise(
    unique_sites = length(unique(site)),
    obs_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ))

# 1. Temperature Analysis
cat("\n======================================================\n")
cat("1. TEMPERATURE ANALYSIS WITH A & B SENSORS\n")
cat("======================================================\n")
temp_data <- daily_avg_holc %>%
  filter(!is.na(bme_temp_c_avg), !is.na(housing_grade)) %>%
  filter(!(month(timestamp_day) %in% c(6,7,8) & bme_temp_c_avg < 14))

# ANOVA controlling for population density
temp_anova <- aov(bme_temp_c_avg ~ housing_grade + population_density, data = temp_data)
cat("\n--- ANOVA Summary ---\n")
print(summary(temp_anova))

cat("\n--- Post-hoc Tukey Test ---\n")
print(TukeyHSD(temp_anova, "housing_grade"))

# Spearman Partial Correlation
temp_cor_data <- temp_data %>% filter(!is.na(housing_grade_numeric), !is.na(population_density))
cat("\n--- Spearman Partial Correlation (Controlling for Pop Density) ---\n")
print(pcor.test(temp_cor_data$bme_temp_c_avg, temp_cor_data$housing_grade_numeric, 
                temp_cor_data[, c("population_density")], method = "spearman"))

# 2. PM2.5 AQI Analysis (Corrected PM2.5)
cat("\n======================================================\n")
cat("2. PM2.5 AQI ANALYSIS WITH A & B SENSORS\n")
cat("======================================================\n")
pm25_redlining <- daily_avg_holc %>%
  filter(!is.na(aqi_pm25_corrected)) %>%
  mutate(aqi_pm25_corrected = ifelse(aqi_pm25_corrected < 0, 0, aqi_pm25_corrected))

pm25_anova_res <- run_redlining_anova(pm25_redlining, "aqi_pm25_corrected")
cat("\n--- ANOVA Summary ---\n")
print(pm25_anova_res$summary)

if (!is.null(pm25_anova_res) && pm25_anova_res$significant) {
  cat("\nSignificant differences found. Post-hoc letters:\n")
  print(pm25_anova_res$letters)
}

# Spearman partial correlation
pm25_cor_data <- pm25_redlining %>% filter(!is.na(housing_grade_numeric), !is.na(population_density))
cat("\n--- Spearman Partial Correlation (Controlling for Pop Density) ---\n")
print(pcor.test(pm25_cor_data$aqi_pm25_corrected, pm25_cor_data$housing_grade_numeric, 
                pm25_cor_data[, c("population_density")], method = "spearman"))

# 3. PM10 AQI Analysis (Original PM10)
cat("\n======================================================\n")
cat("3. PM10 AQI ANALYSIS WITH A & B SENSORS\n")
cat("======================================================\n")
pm10_redlining <- daily_avg_holc %>%
  filter(!is.na(aqi_pm10_original)) %>%
  mutate(aqi_pm10_original = ifelse(aqi_pm10_original < 0, 0, aqi_pm10_original))

pm10_anova_res <- run_redlining_anova(pm10_redlining, "aqi_pm10_original")
cat("\n--- ANOVA Summary ---\n")
print(pm10_anova_res$summary)

if (!is.null(pm10_anova_res) && pm10_anova_res$significant) {
  cat("\nSignificant differences found. Post-hoc letters:\n")
  print(pm10_anova_res$letters)
}

# Spearman partial correlation
pm10_cor_data <- pm10_redlining %>% filter(!is.na(housing_grade_numeric), !is.na(population_density))
cat("\n--- Spearman Partial Correlation (Controlling for Pop Density) ---\n")
print(pcor.test(pm10_cor_data$aqi_pm10_original, pm10_cor_data$housing_grade_numeric, 
                pm10_cor_data[, c("population_density")], method = "spearman"))

# ==============================================================================
# Graphics Replication (with A and B grades)
# ==============================================================================

# Helper function to format numbers to specific significant figures
if (!exists("format_sig_figs")) {
  format_sig_figs <- function(x, n = 2) {
    s <- formatC(signif(x, n), digits = n, format = "g", flag = "#")
    sub("[.]$", "", s)
  }
}

# Define HOLC redlining map colors
holc_colors_all <- c(
  "A: Best" = "#4CAF50",
  "B: Still Desirable" = "#2196F3",
  "C: Declining" = "#FFC107",
  "D: Hazardous" = "#F44336",
  "IC: Industrial" = "#89C4E1",
  "Not Graded" = "#757575"
)

# 1. PM2.5 Density (Raincloud) Plot Replication
cat("\nGenerating PM2.5 redlining density plot with A and B grades...\n")
pm25_data_plot <- pm25_redlining %>%
  mutate(
    housing_grade_label = case_when(
      housing_grade == "A" ~ "A: Best",
      housing_grade == "B" ~ "B: Still Desirable",
      housing_grade == "C" ~ "C: Declining",
      housing_grade == "D" ~ "D: Hazardous",
      housing_grade == "IC" ~ "IC: Industrial",
      housing_grade == "Not Graded" ~ "Not Graded",
      TRUE ~ as.character(housing_grade)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(housing_grade_label = factor(housing_grade_label, 
                                      levels = c("A: Best", "B: Still Desirable", "D: Hazardous", "C: Declining", "Not Graded", "IC: Industrial")))

ref_mean_pm25 <- mean(pm25_data_plot$aqi_pm25_corrected[pm25_data_plot$housing_grade_label == "Not Graded"], na.rm = TRUE)

grade_stats_pm25 <- pm25_data_plot %>%
  group_by(housing_grade_label) %>%
  summarise(
    grade_mean = mean(aqi_pm25_corrected, na.rm = TRUE),
    peak_density = max(density(aqi_pm25_corrected, na.rm = TRUE)$y),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff = grade_mean - ref_mean_pm25,
    delta_label = case_when(
      housing_grade_label == "Not Graded" ~ "Δ0",
      diff > 0 ~ sprintf("Δ+%s", format_sig_figs(diff, 2)),
      diff < 0 ~ sprintf("Δ−%s", format_sig_figs(abs(diff), 2)),
      TRUE ~ "Δ±0"
    ),
    label_x = (grade_mean + ref_mean_pm25) / 2,
    xmin = pmin(grade_mean, ref_mean_pm25),
    xmax = pmax(grade_mean, ref_mean_pm25)
  )

raincloud_fig_all <- ggplot(pm25_data_plot, aes(x = aqi_pm25_corrected)) +
  geom_density(
    aes(fill = housing_grade_label, color = housing_grade_label),
    alpha = 0.82, linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = dplyr::filter(grade_stats_pm25, grade_mean > ref_mean_pm25),
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = housing_grade_label),
    alpha = 0.3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = dplyr::filter(grade_stats_pm25, grade_mean <= ref_mean_pm25),
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    fill = "grey50",
    alpha = 0.3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = ref_mean_pm25,
    linetype   = "dashed",
    color      = "grey50",
    linewidth  = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = grade_stats_pm25,
    aes(xintercept = grade_mean, color = housing_grade_label),
    linetype    = "solid",
    linewidth   = 0.9,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data  = grade_stats_pm25,
    aes(x = grade_mean, y = peak_density, label = delta_label),
    vjust       = -1.0,
    hjust       = -0.40,
    size        = 4.5,
    fontface    = "plain",
    color       = "grey10",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = holc_colors_all, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = holc_colors_all, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 85),
    breaks = seq(0, 80, by = 10),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.10))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.40))) +
  facet_wrap(~ housing_grade_label, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Daily Mean PM"["2.5"] ~ "AQI"),
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 10, face = "plain", color = "grey15",
                                     hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey15", face = "plain",
                                     margin = margin(t = 3)),
    axis.text.y       = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y       = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x       = element_line(color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks.x      = element_line(color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(2.5, "pt"),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey10", face = "plain",
                                     margin = margin(t = 6)),
    panel.spacing     = unit(1.0, "lines"),
    panel.background  = element_blank(),
    plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin       = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 15)
  )

ggsave("figures/raincloud_holc_aqi_purpleair.pdf", plot = raincloud_fig_all, device = cairo_pdf, width = 6.9, height = 9.5)
ggsave("figures/raincloud_holc_aqi_purpleair.png", plot = raincloud_fig_all, width = 6.9, height = 9.5, dpi = 300)

# 2. Temperature Ridgeline (Density) Plot Replication
```
